title: Marin County Jail Video & Audio from 7:00 am to 8:30 am on Sunday, October 26, 2026

communications.communication:
To Whom It May Concern:

Pursuant to the California Public Records Act, I hereby request the following records:

Sonya Foree
341 Paloma Avenue 
San Rafael, CA 94901
415-342-6145
Sonya.foree@mindspring.com
 
Date: 10/30/2026
Public Records Act Coordinator
Marin County Sheriff's Office
1600 Los Gamos Drive, Suite 200
San Rafael, CA 94903
 
Submitted via: County of Marin NextRequest portal (marincountyca.nextrequest.com) and MuckRock.com
 
RE: California Public Records Act Request - Marin County Jail Video and Audio Footage, Sunday, October 25, 2026, 7:00 a.m. to 8:30 a.m.
IMMEDIATE PRESERVATION REQUESTED
To whom it may concern:
Pursuant to the California Public Records Act (Government Code section 7920.000 et seq.) and Article I, section 3(b) of the California Constitution, I respectfully request copies of the following public records maintained by the Marin County Sheriff's Office:
Records Requested
I am requesting video (and, if available, audio) footage from 7:00 a.m. to 8:30 a.m. on Sunday, October 25, 2026, from the Marin County Jail, 13 Peter Behr Drive, San Rafael, CA 94903. I am specifically interested in all public areas, including:
•       Interior public areas, including but not limited to:
◦       the upstairs waiting area;
◦       the elevator; and
◦       the downstairs lobby.
•       Exterior public areas: the exterior of the jail entrance, extending to the left and to the right for 200 feet, covering both the sidewalk and the road.
This request includes footage from every camera or recording device capturing any of the areas described above during the stated time period, together with any associated audio recordings.
Request for Immediate Preservation
I respectfully request that all footage responsive to this request be preserved immediately and kept until the final resolution of this public records request. Because many surveillance systems automatically overwrite recordings on a short cycle, I ask that the Sheriff's Office take prompt steps to suspend any automatic deletion or overwriting of the responsive footage, and that no responsive footage be destroyed, deleted, or overwritten while this request, including any appeal or legal challenge, remains pending.
Format of Production
Pursuant to Government Code section 7922.570, I request that the footage be provided in electronic form, in its native digital format or another commonly used format (such as MP4), with original timestamps intact. Electronic delivery through the NextRequest portal, a secure download link, or email is preferred. If physical media is required, please advise me of the cost in advance and I will provide the digital drive necessary.
Exemptions and Redactions
If the Sheriff's Office determines that any portion of the requested footage is exempt from disclosure, I ask that it release all reasonably segregable, non-exempt portions, as required by Government Code section 7922.525, with only the minimum redaction necessary (for example, blurring rather than withholding entire recordings). If any portion of this request is denied, please provide the denial in writing, cite the specific legal authority relied upon, and state the names and titles or positions of each person responsible for the denial, as required by Government Code section 7922.540.
If no footage exists for any of the areas described above (for example, because a camera was not operating or does not record audio), I ask that you please identify the area or camera and state that no responsive record exists for it.
Response Time and Fees
Government Code section 7922.535 requires a determination within 10 days of receipt of this request as to whether it seeks disclosable public records in your possession. I understand that I may be charged only the direct cost of duplication under Government Code section 7922.530. 
If you have any questions or need clarification to locate the requested records, please contact me through my email listed above. 
Thank you for your time and assistance.
Respectfully,
Sonya Foree

The requested documents will be made available to the general public, and this request is not being made for commercial purposes.

In the event that there are fees, I would be grateful if you would inform me of the total charges in advance of fulfilling my request. I would prefer the request filled electronically, by e-mail attachment if available or CD-ROM if not.

Thank you in advance for your anticipated cooperation in this matter. I look forward to receiving your response to this request within 10 calendar days, as the statute requires.

Sincerely,

Sonya Felman Foree
